CustomField.description: This is for visibility of System Admin, Utkarsh Admin, and Same dept CRM Head, HOD
CustomField.formula:
OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh Admin",
AND( Department__c = $User.Department, OR( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh HOD", $Profile.Name = "CRM Head" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Department Match without Owner
